items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Brady Smith, Walter Daniel, uh, Silver Guster Handy, myself, and uh, that's about all.

ctx.x: Okay, it's going to second reel of John L. Jones, June the 5th, 1972. Okay? Mm-hmm. Let's see, you want me to ask you something? Yeah, you. I asked you about Kid Renee. Uh-huh. And you said you played with him at the Cadillac? At the Cadillac. Who was in the band then?
Brady Smith, Walter Daniel, uh, Silver Guster Handy, myself, and uh, that's about all.
